description.zh: 镜像ID。如何获取镜像ID，请参见[ListImages](~~449118~~)  。
description.en: The image ID. You can call [ListImages](~~449118~~) to obtain the image ID.

description.zh:
标签过滤条件，多个条件以逗号分隔。
单个条件过滤格式为`key=value`。
与LabelKeys分别独立生效。
description.en: The tag filter conditions, separated with commas (,). The format of a single condition filter is `key=value`. Takes effect independently from LabelKeys.

description.zh:
标签键的列表，以半角逗号（,）分隔。
系统标签以system开头，与LabelFilter分别独立生效。
description.en: The tag keys, separated with commas (,). System tags start with system and take effect independently from LabelFilter.
The region where the image resides.

description.zh: 工作空间ID。如何获取工作空间ID，请参见[ListWorkspaces](~~449124~~)。
description.en: The workspace ID. You can call [ListWorkspaces](~~449124~~) to obtain the workspace ID.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun aiworkspace list-image-labels --label-keys system.framework,system.official --label-filter system.framework=XGBoost_1.6.0,system.official=true --image-id image-4c6200000053uor --workspace-id 12345 --biz-region cn-shanghai --region cn-hangzhou
